name: incnt_stmt_quota_attainment_ranked
xsql:
SELECT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      quota_name,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      attainment_pct,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
      arc_pct,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      total_credit,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      quota_amount,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      disp,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
      SeqNum() AS ord                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  FROM (                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      SELECT quota_name, attainment_pct, arc_pct, total_credit, quota_amount, disp, tgt_raw                                                                                                                                                                                    
      FROM incnt_stmt_quota_base                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
      ORDER BY tgt_raw,quota_name DESC                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  )
